theorem backend.lastVal_append_single (l : List backend.Ent) (e : backend.Ent) (k : GoString) :
    backend.lastVal (l ++ [e]) k = if e.fst = k then some e.snd else backend.lastVal l k

    <[k := v]>(backend.bktOf S n)]>S) n' !! kc = if n = n' ∧ k = kc then some v else backend.bktOf S
    n' !! kc

    backend.BktData) (n' : GoString) : <[n := f (backend.bktOf S n)]>S !! n' = if n = n' then some
